messages:
anya: Heads-up — customer reported bulk SCIM failures after yesterday's RBAC role-map change. Lots of deprovision/no-group-assignment symptoms. Seeing 403s from SCIM webhook and KMS errors in the provisioner logs.
kevin: Ok — can you paste the exact SCIM error and the KMS log line?
anya: SCIM: `POST /scim/v2/Users` -> 403 {"detail":"forbidden: role-mapping denied"}
anya: KMS log (provisioner instance p-3): `ERROR: kms: decrypt failed: envelope context mismatch (key alias arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/abc123)`
samir: @anya did the role-map change include switching the NameID->externalId mapping? We had a PR that changed samAccountName->email as externalId last night.
anya: yeah that PR changed externalId to use `user.email` instead of `user.sAMAccountName` for Okta->SCIM mapping. Intended for new accounts only.
lisa: That could cause dup detection to fail if Okta is still sending NameID in old format. Are we dropping extid on update?
kevin: I grep'd the audit logs — when NameID changed, our provisioner tries to decrypt the stored extid envelope before comparing; KMS failing causes provisioner to bail with 403. The decrypt error is the root.
anya: Example trace on a single account: ```Provisioner: fetch user record -> found extid envelope v2 -> kms.Decrypt(ctx) -> error: envelope context mismatch -> abort -> return 403 to SCIM caller```
sec-bot: Incident alert: SCIM provisioning error rate spike (5xx/403) — triggered at 2026-03-23T09:42:11Z.
samir: Context mismatch usually means the envelope was created with a different key alias or different encryption context values. Did the key rotation run last night?
kevin: Ops ran a KMS rewrap job at 02:10 UTC on a subset of tenants — but should have been scoped to 'prod-batch-2025' only. Looking into runbook.
lisa: If rewrap changed envelope context (we add tenant_id to context), older envelopes without tenant_id will fail to decrypt. Provisioner should fallback to legacy context for migration.
anya: We should triage scope: are all customers affected or subset? Customer support shows ~12 orgs, mostly OKTA-backed.
samir: Quick check: list affected users and try manual KMS decrypt with alternate contexts. If manual decrypt succeeds with empty context, then rewrap altered context and migration needed.
kevin: I ran manual decrypts for 3 accounts. Example: `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://blob.bin --key-id alias/redwood-prod --encryption-context tenant_id=org-123` -> fails. Without encryption-context flag -> succeeds. So new rewrap added tenant_id into contexts, but some envelopes still unrewrapped.
lisa: That explains it — provisioner is now calling KMS with context `{tenant_id}` by default. Old envelopes were created without context, so KMS returns context mismatch. Provisioner should try both contexts.
anya: Proposed immediate mitigation: rollback the provisioning code that requires context, and deploy a patch that attempts legacy decrypt when the contextual decrypt fails. Also schedule a backfill rewrap for remaining envelopes.
samir: Agreed. Quick patch: try decrypt with configured context, on KMS 'InvalidCiphertextException' or 'context mismatch', retry without context, then log metric. We'll need feature-flag to avoid silent fallback forever.
kevin: I'll open a canary PR for provisioner with the try-both logic and a feature flag `scim.kms.legacy-decrypt=true` defaulted to true for next 24h.
anya: Support: I'll message affected customers and pause aggressive reprovisioning retrys to avoid churn.
sec-bot: Deploy pipeline: PR #4023 created by kevin. CI green on unit tests.
lisa: After patch, we should run a one-off job to rewrap extid envelopes using the new context so we can flip feature-flag off. Backfill plan: 1) identify envelopes older than 2026-03-23 02:00Z; 2) rewrap using `kms:ReEncrypt` with new context; 3) verify decrypt with context.
samir: One more caveat: SAML NameID format mismatch — some IdPs started sending transient NameID; that, combined with extid swap, created duplicates during on-boarding. We need to add a normalization step that prefers stable externalId and falls back to NameID only if extid missing.
kevin: I'll include a short-term change to the NameID handling in the PR, but keep it minimal.
anya: Can we schedule rewrap job in maintenance window? Ops, please advise.
kevin: I'll coordinate with infra for low-load window tonight 03:00-04:00 UTC.
lisa: After rewrap job, we should run sampling verification across affected tenants and emit `scim.provisioning.kms_legacy_decrypt_count` metric.
anya: Thanks team. I'll create a support incident doc and a postmortem stub.
sec-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-03123 (owners: anya, kevin).
kevin: Rolling patch to canary cluster now. Monitoring logs for KMS errors and SCIM 403s.
anya: Update: canary shows immediate drop in 403s after fallback enabled. Still need full rewrap backfill. I'll update INC-2026-03123 with timeline. :white_check_mark:
